name: ═══════════════ SLIDING GATE TELEGRAM INTERFACE ═══════════════
info:
## Sliding Gate Telegram Interface

Provides Telegram bot commands for sliding gate control.

### Commands:
- /sliding_open - Open sliding gate (Relay 1)
- /sliding_close - Close sliding gate (Relay 2)
- /sliding_trigger - Trigger gate automation (Relay 3)
- /sliding_status - Get sliding gate status
- /sliding_help - Show sliding gate commands

### Dependencies:
- Requires: telegram_bot_config (from 50-telegram-interface.json)
- Uses: Same Telegram bot as server management and main gate
